text:
elena-cs: Oakhurst final go/no-go for private deploy tomorrow. Two open items from their security reviewer: (1) KMS customer key has KeyRotationEnabled=false, (2) VPC flow / audit logs not landing in their compliance S3 bucket. They're flagging SOC2 evidence and said they may pause cutover if unresolved. Any quick blockers?

li-infra: I'm looking. Their CMK is customer-owned and cross-account access is configured. Enabling automatic rotation is fine from an encryption standpoint (re-encrypt not required). I'll wait for a thumbs up before toggling.

jordan-se: On the logs: our agent shows repeated errors: `BucketPolicyMissingPrincipal: principal arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/redwood-priv-batch not found` when trying PutObject. The bucket policy pins an IAM user instead of the deployment role.

sam-platform: Suggested remediation and notes: 
1) KMS: `aws kms enable-key-rotation --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999999999999:key/abcd-1234` (non-disruptive).
2) S3 policy example to add: ```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/redwood-priv-batch"},
  "Action": "s3:PutObject",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::oakhurst-compliance-logs/*"
}
```
Also recommend server-side encryption with SSE-KMS using their CMK for the log objects.

elena-cs: Customer response: "We need logs in our bucket with KMS envelope and 365d retention for audit. Please confirm timeline." Renewal risk = elevated until logs are flowing.

li-infra: I can enable rotation now and notify them. For retention I propose 30d standard + 335d Glacier Deep Archive to meet 365d retention with minimal cost. That keeps hot window for quick lookup. Want me to send a cost delta?

jordan-se: From product/devex feedback: installer currently surfaces the error as `Permission denied writing to bucket` which is unhelpful. I'll add a specific check that validates the presence of a role principal in the bucket policy and return: `Missing required principal arn:aws:iam::\d{12}:role/redwood-priv-batch in bucket policy` if not found. Will submit PR.

sam-platform: ETA for PR + staging deploy: ~4 hours. I can coordinate a dry run with Oakhurst at 10:30 PT tomorrow.

elena-cs: Action list: li - enable rotation + send retention cost delta to customer; jordan - installer validation PR; sam - schedule 10:30 PT dry run and notify Oakhurst. I'll update renewal scoreboard (amber currently). Capture customer feedback: docs lack a clear example of required bucket policy and SSE-KMS guidance.

li-infra: KMS rotation enabled ✔️ 3322104378. I pinged security contact.

jordan-se: PR opened: #4125 `installer: validate s3 bucket principal for priv deploy` 3322104395. Added error message and link to docs placeholder.

sam-platform: Dry run scheduled and invite sent to Oakhurst for 10:30 PT.

li-infra: After policy change from customer (they updated to include our role) we see PutObject success — sample event: `PutObject Succeeded, x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms` 3322104400

elena-cs: Great — updating renewal scorecard to green. I'll file a docs ticket to add a dedicated section for "Priv deploy: S3 bucket policy + SSE-KMS example" and include the retention recommendation. Thanks team :thumbsup:
